dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A novel by Kanya Siriwong. She's my favorite author.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈnɑːvəl baɪ ˈkɑːnjə ˈsɪriwɔːŋ. ʃiːz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈɔːθər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Has she written a lot of books?
dialogue.reading: hæz ʃiː ˈrɪtən ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈbʊks?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, she's published five novels, and three of them have become bestsellers.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ʃiːz ˈpʌblɪʃt ˈfaɪv ˈnɑːvəlz, ənd ˈθriː əv ðɛm hæv bɪˈkʌm ˌbɛstˈsɛlərz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Wow. Have any of them been translated into English?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ. hæv ˈɛni əv ðɛm bɪn trænsˈleɪtɪd ɪntə ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Two of them have. Her books have inspired a lot of young Thai writers.
dialogue.reading: ˈtuː əv ðɛm ˈhæv. hɜːr ˈbʊks hæv ɪnˈspaɪərd ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈjʌŋ ˈtaɪ ˈraɪtərz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Who influenced her? Do you know?
dialogue.reading: ˈhuː ˈɪnfluənst hɜːr? duː juː ˈnoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sunthorn Phu. He was a famous writer who lived about two hundred years ago.
dialogue.reading: ˈsʊntɔːrn ˈpuː. hiː wʌz ə ˈfeɪməs ˈraɪtər huː ˈlɪvd əˈbaʊt ˈtuː ˈhʌndrəd ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, he wrote very long stories that people still read today.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, hiː ˈroʊt ˈvɛri ˈlɔːŋ ˈstɔːriz ðæt ˈpiːpəl ˈstɪl ˈriːd təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: So he influenced a lot of writers after him.
dialogue.reading: soʊ hiː ˈɪnfluənst ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈraɪtərz ˈæftər ˈhɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. And Kanya says she has read his stories a hundred times!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ənd ˈkɑːnjə ˈsɛz ʃiː hæz ˈriːd hɪz ˈstɔːriz ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈtaɪmz!
